description: Record a company, holding or structure the signed-in member owns, as on Heed's Companies page: name, country, form (company, holding, trust, foundation, partnership, SPV, branch, other), incorporation date, ownership share, status and purpose. Its country then feeds the member's change feed. This writes to their real record: confirm the details in words first. Returns the company as stored, with its id.

country.description: Country of incorporation, name or two-letter code.

form.description: company (default), holding, trust, foundation, partnership, spv, branch or other.

notes.description: A note for the member's own record.

purpose.description: operating, startup, holding, trading, ip, spv, personal or other.

name: add_company
title: Add a company
